title: Love it!
text: Love it!. I really love this shower curtain!  The colors are beautiful!  I used an orange rug and towels to finish off the bathroom.  It's perfect!

product_metadata.title: Emery Fabric Shower Curtain, 70"x70", Colorful Floral Geometric Printed Design
features: Liven up and add stylish look to any bathroom. Perfect for bathtubs for your home, campers, motels, hotels, dorms and more. This shower curtain creates a beautiful look that makes your bathroom pop
Bring in a breath of elegance for your bathroom with this canvas shower curtain in paisley, geometric & floral design
Water Proof - 100% water proof made with durable polyester fabric. Best used with an interior shower curtain liner (not included)
Fits many standard size shower tub that works with straight or curved shower rods. Shower curtain size is 70"x70". Built-in ring holes make installation easy (rings not included)
Easy Care, Machine Washable Durable Fabric - machine wash cold with Hang to dry. Wipes clean with a damp cloth. Do not bleach.
description: Spruce up your bathroom with this great quality fabric canvas shower curtain Emery by Linen Store. This shower curtain features a beautiful and colorful paisley floral design in Green/Orange tone on White canvas. Perfect bathroom decor for bathtubs and showers. Shower curtain size is 70 inch x 70 inch. Made of 100% Polyester. Care instruction : Machine was cold. Do not bleach. Hang to dry. Low iron if needed.
